plan: OpenVibe.Quest — the network's shared quest and rewards system: one quest log across every OpenVibe site, rewards as badges and OpenCoins (loyalty, never money), community-made quests later
summary: OpenVibe.Quest: one quest log across every OpenVibe site. OpenVibe.Events delivers the domain events the sites already emit to POST /internal/events (signed v2, once-only through the openvibe-sdk inbox), the person taken from the field each event's own schema defines, and a progress count, a completion and a badge move because of it. 12 first-party quests in code, grouped by the site whose events each counts. Rewards are badges and OpenCoins — credited through OpenVibe.Network's wallet, off by default (QUEST_COINS), with per-person and network-wide daily caps, failures recorded and retried. Public API and server-rendered pages, complete without JavaScript. Not deployed; OpenCoins are off until Network grants the two capabilities.
works: The quest catalog in code (12 quests, 8 sites) and the whole list of events it listens to, with a load-time check that no quest counts an undocumented event
POST /internal/events exactly as OpenVibe.Space does it: raw body, parseDelivery requireV2, the openvibe-sdk inbox, forwarding headers refused, 503 without QUEST_EVENTS_SECRET
Subscriptions created at boot for the catalog's events (idempotent, off without QUEST_EVENTS_URL / QUEST_EVENTS_SECRET)
The person taken from the event's own schema field (channel.subject, follower, author, user_subject, player.subject, owner); an event with no usr_ subject, a guest or a service is ignored
Progress per step, one completion per person per quest and one badge per person, all once-only under a redelivery
OpenCoins through OpenVibe.Network's wallet (network.coins.credit, app_id quest), idempotency_key = the completion id, subject resolved to the wallet's user id through identity.resolve
QUEST_COINS off by default (coins_state=skipped, the pages say the rewards start soon); per-person (50) and network-wide (5000) daily caps; a failure recorded with its reason and retried by a timer
GET /api/v1/quests, /quests/:id, /me/quests (a signed-in person's own log), /profiles/:subject/badges (id, name and date only)

Pages: home (the quests grouped by site, how progress works), a quest, your quest log (plain <progress> bars), the rules, the update log; robots, sitemap with every quest page, llms.txt, llms-full.txt

Tests on temp PGlite databases with a mock Network that also serves the wallet: signature refusal, idempotent replay, counting to completion, badge once, coins off, coins on with caps and a retry, events with no subject ignored, /me requires sign-in, hostile titles escaped

Account export and deletion (ADR-033): the quest progress, completions and badges a person has are exported to OpenVibe.Network on network.account.export_requested and deleted whole on network.account.deleted, with the counts confirmed back; the two account topics join the catalog's events in the boot subscriptions (server/identity/account-data.js)
notYet: A deployment: the service is not registered with OpenVibe.Services nor deployed by OpenVibe.Host, and its capabilities are not in openvibe-contracts yet (no quest.* manifest exists)
OpenCoins are off in production until OpenVibe.Network grants the quest client identity.subject.resolve and network.coins.credit
Community-made quests (streamers, communities, mods): they need moderation, which this release does not have
Repeatable quests and seasonal resets: every quest completes once per person

Account merges (ADR-029): quest_progress, quest_completions and quest_badges rows are not re-keyed when a Network account is merged into another (deletion is answered, ADR-033; a merge's aliases are erased with the account)
Quest chains, leaderboards and per-community quests; a streamer's getting-started steps still live on OpenVibe.Live
